page_note: Heavily damaged page (91.4%) entirely focused on the Manichaean ecclesial practice of the 'four gates' of mercy/remembrance performed by the holy church for the deceased catechumen. The fatigue score (+16.8 in second half) confirms intensifying ecclesial vocabulary. Substrate is essentially absent except for a brief cosmological aside (segs 7-9) describing the living soul mingled in the cosmos and her purification/redemption — this is genuine substrate language about the soul's cosmic condition, embedded as a justification for the ecclesial practices. The 'four gates' enumeration here is NOT cosmological but ecclesial-institutional (gates of church mercy: rest, prayer, remembrance, almsgiving by the catechumen).
